feature: Shopping for all decks v2, the no-friends half (companion to all-decks-cart-v2.json)
note: Empty-One C, By friend for a reader with no friends: the server decides it from the friend count, so it is reachable only on an account with no friends, where every By friend panel row of all-decks-cart-v2.json cannot be. Run the two inventories on the account each one needs (on local-dev, which holds no friend_links, this one). Needs a server with ALL_DECKS_CART_ENABLED=true, SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED=true and SPARE_REQUESTS_ENABLED=true, and decks missing cards.

shares.note: The app's dashed empty-state block, as By friend's no-friends block draws it.

rows.label: /decks/shopping?view=friend for a reader with no friends: the dashed block with the spare glyph, `No friends yet`, the one press Go to Friends, `0 friends`, and no By friend column header (Empty-One C)
